Our Story

A Love Letter to Korean Coffee

We believe every cup of coffee tells a story — of culture, of people, and of traditions preserved through generations.

From carefully selected beans grown in Korea's most renowned regions to meticulously crafted brewing methods, we are dedicated to delivering the perfect coffee experience. We don't just serve coffee; we share the stories and cultural values that make Korean coffee culture unique.

01

Sourced from the Finest Korean Coffee Regions

We select only the finest beans from Korea's most renowned growing regions. Each bean is carefully tended, harvested at peak ripeness, and processed using traditional methods combined with modern technology to deliver the richest, most authentic flavor profile.

Learn More →
02

Hand-Selected Tea Leaves from Mountain Highlands

From the misty highlands, we bring you the finest tea leaves. Each leaf is hand-picked and specially processed to preserve its natural flavor and beneficial properties. Our tea is more than a beverage — it's an experience of Korean nature and culture.
